mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production signals a supply shock that negatively impacts S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 1% INDPRO drop.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market that negatively impacts consumer spending and S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of periods following a 0.5pp UNRATE rise.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy that negatively impacts S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp FEDFUNDS rise.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts signals a weakening housing market that negatively impacts S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of months following a decline in housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following a 300k PAYEMS increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the consumer price index signals rising inflation that erodes real equity returns and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5% CPIAUCSL rise.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real retail sales signals a weakening consumer demand environment that negatively impacts S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 1% RSAFS decline.
